commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Javi Lopez (Alaves) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles over the bar.

90+5' Kike Garcia (Alaves) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable save to keep the ball from hitting the net. What a save!
90+2' Samu (Alaves) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon was alert and made an amazing save!
90+2' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle and it's Xeber Alkain (Alaves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
87' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
87' The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
86' Jon Guridi (Alaves) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
86' The resulting free kick from Javi Lopez (Alaves) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
84' Substitution. Xeber Alkain (Alaves) in, Luis Rioja out.
84' Wasted opportunity. Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
82' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta is substituted due to injury. Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives a chance to Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
82' Here is a change. Yuri Berchiche is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao).
82' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
81' The attendance for today's match is 19421.
81' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
77' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Alejandro Ruiz signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Ath Bilbao players celebrate.
76' The Ath Bilbao players halt their celebrations as referee Alejandro Ruiz makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

76' 0 - 2 Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) finds himself in a great shooting position after receiving a low pass from Inaki Williams just outside the box. He unleashes a spectacular first-timer which goes in off the inside of the left post. Phenomenal stuff! 0:2.
76' A pass from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.
73' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

73' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
71' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Aitor Paredes is replaced by Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao).
71' It is time for a substitution. Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) is on for Gorka Guruzeta.

69' He should have scored! Kike Garcia (Alaves) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Unai Simon makes an easy save.
69' The total number of attempts is 7:8. 2:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
67' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Alex Sola and he is replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
67' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Samu (Alaves) replaces Ianis Hagi.
65' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
64' Substitution. Alex Berenguer did his best and is replaced by Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao).
64' Ander Guevara (Alaves) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
64' Alaves win a corner.

64' Chance! Alex Sola (Alaves) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the top of the net, but Unai Simon is alert and makes a great save to deny him. Alaves force a corner. They send men into the box.
62' Poorly taken free kick by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) from mid-range. He unleashes a strong shot, but it goes well wide of the right post. What a miskick!
62' Having seen unsporting behavior, Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Luis Garcia Plaza (Alaves) is the recipient.

60' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
59' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.

57' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
56' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is about to take a corner kick.
55' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' Luis Rioja (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jon Guridi (Alaves) replacing Carlos Benavidez.
48' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ruben Duarte limps off the pitch to be replaced by Javi Lopez (Alaves).
48' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
47' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kike Garcia (Alaves) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) latches on to the corner kick inside the box, but his header crashes against the crossbar! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
45' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.

44' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball is out of play and Ath Bilbao manage to earn a corner.
42' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kike Garcia (Alaves).
39' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement.
36' Alex Sola (Alaves) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
34' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
31' The game is interrupted. Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
29' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
29' Kike Garcia (Alaves) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon thwarts him with a great two-handed save.

28' The cross into the penalty area from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
27' 2:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 0:1.
25' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked.
22' CHANCE! Ianis Hagi (Alaves) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Kike Garcia.

18' 0 - 1 Goal! Mikel Vesga displays great vision and sends a pass to Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
17' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
16' Ath Bilbao players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
10' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Kike Garcia (Alaves), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
10' Alaves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
7' Ander Guevara (Alaves) attempts to find Kike Garcia, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
6' A cross into the box from Luis Rioja (Alaves) is cleared.
6' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
4' Alex Sola (Alaves) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
2' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is flagged for offside.
